coverage_summary: Most input paths are conservatively represented, including unresolved tokenization, prompt construction, fusion algebra, and the undocumented 1.5B variant. Revision is required for omitted documented model branches, post-GRPO evaluation, and the GPT-OSS synthesis output link.

findings.detail: The GeneAgent trajectory is labeled as BFT-only, while the cited paper states that the framework replaces GPT-4o with SFT-, DFT-, and BFT-aligned 70B models. The SFT and DFT model-input branches are missing or their shared input path is not explicitly bound to those variants.

evidence.quote: for biological process reasoning, we use the GeneAgent [9] framework and replace its default GPT-4o backbone with SFT/DFT/BFT-aligned 70B models

findings.required_change: Add separate SFT, DFT, and BFT GeneAgent trajectories, or explicitly document reuse of the reconstructed GeneAgent context path for each model variant.

findings.detail: The VCWorld trajectory covers only the BFT-aligned 70B model, although the paper documents SFT-, DFT-, and BFT-aligned 70B replacements. The omitted variants are part of the documented evaluation path.

evidence.quote: We replace the Gemini-2.5Flash backbone in the VCWorld framework with SFT-, DFT-, and BFT-aligned DeepSeek-R1-Distill 70B models.

findings.required_change: Add the SFT and DFT VCWorld model variants, or explicitly bind the same opaque VCWorld input construction to all three documented aligned backbones.

findings.detail: The GRPO trajectory is restricted to BFT initialization, but the cited evidence documents GRPO starting from DFT, SFT, BFT-sample, BFT-token, and full BFT 70B backbones. The corresponding model branches are absent.

evidence.quote: Starting from the DFT, SFT, BFT-sample, BFT-token, and BFTaligned 70B backbones, we apply GRPO using sparse binary rewards from Tahoe-100M [32]

findings.required_change: Add the documented SFT, DFT, BFT-sample, and BFT-token GRPO variants, preserving their shared Tahoe-100M context path where applicable.

findings.detail: The GRPO trajectory represents training inputs and rewards but omits the documented downstream evaluation on five held-out VCWorld cell lines. The earlier VCWorld trajectory does not identify this post-GRPO held-out evaluation branch.

evidence.quote: To assess RL compatibility, we further train SFT/DFT/BFT-aligned LLMs with GRPO on 45 Tahoe-100M cell lines [32] using sparse binary rewards and evaluate on the five held-out VCWorld cell lines.
Starting from the DFT, SFT, BFT-sample, BFT-token, and BFTaligned 70B backbones, we apply GRPO using sparse binary rewards from Tahoe-100M [32] and evaluate again on the held-out VCWorld cell lines.

findings.required_change: Add a post-GRPO evaluation step or trajectory with held-out VCWorld cell-line inputs and an opaque evaluation-context receipt, while keeping the GRPO training branch separate.

findings.detail: The GPT-OSS trajectory ends at an opaque conditioning context and has no output for the instruction-response pairs that the paper says GPT-OSS synthesizes. The same biological_instruction_response_pairs node is created in a DeepSeek fine-tuning trajectory, so the GPT-OSS receipt-to-output provenance is not explicit.

evidence.quote: biomedical corpus from NCBI is used as the knowledge source in EasyDataset [30], and GPT-OSS-120B [31] synthesizes instruction-response pairs covering broad biological knowledge.

findings.required_change: Add a GPT-OSS synthesis step producing biological_instruction_response_pairs, or add an explicit cross-trajectory edge linking gpt_oss_model_context to that downstream dataset node.
